recipe.name: Smashed Potatoes With Bacon & Eggs
recipe.description: Crisp oven-smashed potatoes on a bed of greens, topped with eggs fried in bacon fat, crumbled bacon, a spicy sour cream drizzle and scallions.

ingredients.ingredient_name: Large russet potatoes, scrubbed and pricked with a fork
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, for the potatoes
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, for the sauce
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, for the eggs
Olive oil, for frying the eggs
Crunchy lettuce or tender greens (e.g., arugula, spinach)
Scallions, thinly sliced on the bias

steps: Bake the pricked potatoes whole on a baking sheet for 50–60 minutes, until very soft.
Press each hot potato flat on the baking sheet with a flat pan lid, protecting your hand from the heat.
Drizzle the potatoes with the olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 15 minutes until crisp, then turn the oven off and leave them inside.
Whisk the sour cream and hot sauce, if using, in a small bowl, adding water until thin enough to drizzle. Season with salt and pepper.
Fry the bacon slowly in a large skillet on medium-low, about 15 minutes, until crisp. Lift it out onto a plate.
Pour most of the bacon fat into a heatproof cup, leaving a generous layer in the skillet.
Fry the eggs a few at a time over medium heat, spooning hot fat over them, until the whites are set and the edges lacy. Season with salt and pepper.
Add some of the saved bacon fat or a little extra olive oil between batches if the skillet looks dry.
Pile the greens on plates and top each with one potato, two eggs and crumbled bacon. Drizzle with the sauce and scatter the scallions over.
You nailed it! Grab a plate and dig in.
